name: relief-os-monorepo
description: AAROH - AI-Powered Disaster Response & Resource Intelligence

scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('apps/web/dist')) { if(fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync('apps/web/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true }); }"
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=@relief-os/web && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('apps/web/dist')) { if(fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync('apps/web/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true }); }"
